items.name: Administrator
items.description: Administrator with access to all content, media, site and settings except owner role management and security keys

items.name: AI Draft Agent
items.description: AI client role: create and update drafts only, assign terms, upload media

items.name: AI Publisher Agent
items.description: AI client role: create, update, publish with approval, manage terms with approval, upload media

items.name: Author
items.description: Can create and edit own entries and submit for review, assign terms, and manage own media

items.name: Contributor
items.description: Can create drafts only and upload media

items.name: Developer
items.description: Developer with schema, API, webhook, plugin and system management access

items.name: Editor
items.description: Can edit, publish, unpublish, schedule, and soft-delete content across all collections, manage terms and media

items.name: Owner
items.description: Full ownership with all permissions across all subjects

items.name: Viewer
items.description: Read-only access to content, taxonomies and media
